name: Halimornis
sum: Enantiornithean from the Campanian Mooreville Chalk of Alabama, found in marine rocks.
holotype: A single individual with vertebrae, leg bones and part of the shoulder girdle (number in Chiappe et al. 2002).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Chiappe et al. 2002

sources.text: Chiappe, Luis; Lamb, James P.; Ericson, PER G. P. 2002. New enantiornithine bird from the marine Upper Cretaceous of Alabama. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 22(1): 170–174. doi:10.1671/0272-4634(2002)022[0170:NEBFTM]2.0.CO;2
